sources.entry: Corona Tracker - Coronavirus tracker app for iOS & macOS with maps & charts.

summary.one_liner: A COVID-19 case tracker app for iOS, iPad, and macOS that shows live global data on an interactive distribution map, with charts and stats.
summary.what_it_does: The app pulls the latest coronavirus data and refreshes it automatically. Its map shows country-level circles when zoomed out and city-level detail when zoomed in, with a red color scale and circle size reflecting confirmed case counts. Charts cover current state, timeline, top affected countries, daily new cases, and cases since the 100th case, with an optional logarithmic scale. Users can search countries and cities, see confirmed, recovered, and death counts with percentages, share stats and charts as images, and view a Today widget for worldwide numbers.
use_cases: Track the latest COVID-19 case counts by country or city
View coronavirus spread on a world map
Compare how fast cases grew across countries
Check worldwide stats from a home screen widget
how_to_run: Choose the iOS or macOS target
Alternatively, download the latest macOS release
Or install via brew: brew cask install corona-tracker
notable: Two-level distribution map: countries when zoomed out, cities when zoomed in
Cases since the 100th case chart for comparing spread across countries
Localized into roughly two dozen languages
Data drawn from JHU CSSE, RKI, BMSGPK, and Bing COVID-19 Tracker
caveats: Built from source requires Xcode; the README does not list a minimum OS version
Installation via brew is shown only for macOS
The README does not state whether the project is still maintained
